theorems.name: Submission.dohr_tp_wtlp_rescaled_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (L : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((t ^ n)⁻¹) * L t) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → (∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), L (r * ρ) ≠ ⊤) ∧ Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (L (r * ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
